scope: Committed source coverage only. Dirty and untracked files are outside this proof. All successors remain draft; coverage is not merge or release approval.
commands: gh pr view NUMBER --repo mekhovov/revealline --json headRefOid,baseRefOid,commits
git diff --find-renames --unified=0 SOURCE_BASE SOURCE -- PATH | git patch-id --stable
git diff --find-renames --unified=0 TARGET_BASE TARGET -- PATH | git patch-id --stable
method: Zero-context stable patch IDs compare changed bytes while excluding surrounding main-integration context. Final blob identities separately establish unchanged outputs. Appended documentation is checked byte-exact as a substring/prefix, not inferred from titles.
limitations: Stable patch IDs ignore whitespace; this is not semantic or CI acceptance.
PR baseRefOid from gh metadata may be stale; explicit source/target parents are pinned for this proof.
Revalidate any moved source or successor head before supersession or merge.
PR256 combines PR233 with PR252 and v0.82.1. Original runtime path deltas are exact, while new-base backup/preflight/session-original behavior is preserved.
No worktree, branch, or PR state mutated.
